concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-management-latest-get-merchants-merchantid-payoutsettings]] — 2026-11-03-captured Management API v3 TEST merchant payout-settings list, requiring Adyen-set access and a payout-settings-read role; bank verification and enabled configuration are distinct, and readback does not prove payout or bank receipt.
